notes: Fleshbook UI reskin. Removed the descriptive blurb at the top of the feed. Restyled the panel to match the platform instead of looking like a separate app: amber and green chrome, IBM Plex Mono, a compact terminal-style header with a PUBLIC FEED label and a live indicator. Faction colours are now reserved for author identity (name plus a left accent stripe per post) rather than used as the panel accent. Upvote is reframed as a signal boost (the up-arrow), GM posts are tagged FLESH CORP, and the composer is tighter. No behaviour changes.
